title: 19 Hartsfield Dr Clarington Open House Video Tour
description:
Welcome to 19 Hartsfield Drive, a semi-detached raised bungalow situated within the Courtice community of Clarington.

This home features a single car garage, 1+2 bedrooms, 2 washrooms, and a fully fenced backyard with an interlock patio as well as a raised deck.

The open themed main level features a spacious living room with a walk-out to the backyard deck; and a light-filled dining area open to the kitchen. There is also a large double coat closet, a storage area, a main washroom, and the master bedroom own the main level.

The lower level has broadloom throughout, and features a family room, a combined laundry area and washroom, plenty of storage, as well as two bedrooms.

This home backs onto Courtice West Park; is walking distance to ST Worden Public School and public transit; and is just a short drive to Kingston Road (Hwy 2) shops and services, the Courtice Community Complex, golf courses, and access to Hwy 401.

For more information, contact Garrek Skillicorn, of Keller Williams Realty Centres, Brokerage, at (416) 420-2148.
